# maas_api_key (Data Source)

Provides details about an existing MAAS API key (authorisation token) for the authenticated user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "maas_api_key" "existing" {
  name = "my-automation-token"
}

output "existing_api_key" {
  value     = data.maas_api_key.existing.api_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name (label) of the API key to look up.

### Read-Only

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The full API key in the format `consumer_key:token_key:token_secret`.
- `consumer_key` (String, Sensitive) The consumer key component of the API key.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `token_key` (String, Sensitive) The token key component of the API key.
- `token_secret` (String, Sensitive) The token secret component of the API key.
